name: Advanced Underground Utility Locating
old_description: in order to have public utilities marked before you dig, but public utility companies will only locate the facilities they own(commonly only up to the meter) This leaves the remaining private utilities unmarked.
about:
Advanced Underground Utility Locating Inc. was founded in 2002 in Bend, Oregon. The company operates offices throughout Oregon and Washington and is licensed to serve California and Idaho.

The firm specializes in private and public utility locating, offering complete utility detection and mapping, advanced utility locating, electrical fault locating, water leak detection, ground penetrating radar scanning, and floor or interior concrete scanning. Technicians use GPS data collection to produce high‑resolution utility maps exportable in KML, KMZ, SHP, and PDF formats, and they also employ drone photogrammetry for geo‑locked aerial imagery. Since inception, the company has completed over 61,900 projects.

Services are aimed at residential, commercial, and industrial clients, including homeowners planning small digs, contractors managing large‑scale construction, and facility managers overseeing complex underground infrastructure. The company notes that its mapping helps avoid costly replanning and damage during excavation.

AUUL differentiates itself with the claim “If We Can’t Find It… It Can’t Be Found,” emphasizing its ability to locate utilities that other providers miss through the latest GPR technology and comprehensive mapping that includes depth, pipe size, and material identification.
